basic_profile.bio: Hailing from a small town in Ohio, I'm a 25-year-old graphic designer with a passion for all things My Chemical Romance. By day, I work for a local design firm, but by night, I'm diving into the world of alternative music and fantasy novels. I'm single and enjoy spending my weekends exploring new music and attending local gigs when possible. I'm typically online during the evenings, especially after 8 PM, when I can unwind and catch up with my favorite communities.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a bachelor's degree in Graphic Design, which helped me develop a keen eye for visual arts. My love for music, particularly bands like My Chemical Romance and Depeche Mode, has driven me to learn more about the music industry and band history. This knowledge is primarily self-taught through documentaries, concerts, and community discussions.
